from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyContractLiability(BaseModel):
    """Contract liability data from one company's Q1 2024 financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    contract_liability_end_balance: float = Field(description="期末合同负债余额 (end of period balance)")
    contract_liability_beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="期初合同负债余额 (beginning of period balance), if reported")
    period: str = Field(description="Report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str = Field(default="元", description="Currency unit for the amounts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_contract_liabilities: list[CompanyContractLiability]
